known_lineage_gaps: The checked-in Gemini notebook and D:\gci\gemini archive notebook are distinct snapshots with different hashes; no evidence identifies which exact snapshot generated the historical artifacts.
The historical Anchor74 zoo prediction archive has no model checkpoints, row IDs, fold assignments, or original run manifest.
The historical V17, V55, and XGB10 prediction arrays have no row-ID sidecars; positional alignment cannot be independently certified for test rows.

V17 trainer refers to D:\gci\codex\v_3_cache\resid16.pkl. The exact path is present and hash-pinned in this audit, but its pickle schema and producer lineage remain unverified; a similarly named .feather file is not interchangeable.
V17/V55/XGB10 raw recreation sources exist, but the prior fresh raw-component run did not reproduce historical predictions.
An exact official evaluation record for the reported 0.801340 score was not independently obtained in this audit.
The V080041 learned upstream artifacts are not direct terms in the V85 formula, but they are part of the V080150 -> V080200 -> Level-2 bedrock ancestry used by Anchor74.
The V20 writer and model ancestry are not recovered; V20 is an input to V080150 and therefore blocks an independent raw rebuild of the historical Anchor74 bedrock chain.
The raw 669/550 feature values and selected order are exactly reproduced; previous SHA differences came from distinct Feather serialization, not differing matrix values.
The independently trained five-family zoo reproduces four cached families exactly; the CatBoost family remains non-exact despite very high correlation.
